sources.title: Wikidata Q220728 (the Fifth Avenue wedge building)

floors.note: floors above ground (P1101): one window band per storey

lengthM.note: length of the wedge along its axis (the S07a kit's stylised plan)

podiumM.note: the low podium's height, set out 0.6 m

readabilityScale.note: Plain massing (LEGAL-1): no thin members, no ornament; windows are bands of glass.

gameScale.note: Game scale (orchestrator decision 2026-10-08, the user may overrule): heights x1.12 and widths x1.2, so the wedge reads beside the real-scale district without leaving the frame's exclusion.
